data.name: Subha
data.gender_notes: Subha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘subh’, meaning ‘good’, ‘auspicious’, ‘beautiful’, and ‘auspicious occasion’. In Hinduism, this name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Subha carries the meaning “Good, auspicious, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Subha usually hope their child will grow to embody good, auspicious, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subha is a name of the Hindu goddess Durga, symbolizing her auspicious and nurturing nature. It is also considered an auspicious name for newborns in Hindu culture.
data.etymology: Subha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good, auspicious, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Subha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
